title: Freedom Yield Metal — A-chain Anchor Receipt v3 (HC-single 4-action pack, chain-discriminated)
description: v3 = v2 plus REQUIRED chain discrimination: anchor.chain_id, anchor.block_id and anchor.chain_profile. Introduced 2026-09-30 to prepare for the announced migration of the Metal A-Chain from the XPR Network (Antelope) to PulseVM, after which a tx_id or block_num alone no longer says which chain it belongs to. The on-chain shape (4 eosio.token::transfer memos in one transaction) and every v2 field are unchanged; only schema_version (3) and the three required fields differ. A v3 receipt can describe a legacy-chain anchor (chain_id 384da888112027f0321850a169f737c33e53b388aad48b5adace4bab97f437e0, chain_profile 'xpr-mainnet'). The generator (scripts/gen-anchor-receipt.sh) writes v2 by default while the default XPR profile is selected, and v3 on request or whenever a non-default chain profile is selected. v2 (/api/anchor-receipt.schema.v2.json) stays published and valid for receipts that declare schema_version 2.

schema_version.description: Receipt schema major. v3 = v2 + required anchor.chain_id / block_id / chain_profile.

schema_version_of_source.description: schema_version of the anchor-source.json that produced this receipt.

chain_backend.description: Names the protocol family observed serving the inscribing transaction — NOT an execution engine. For metal-a-chain this is 'antelope' (Antelope/EOSIO history interfaces — Hyperion /v2/history, /v1/history/get_transaction — plus the Antelope action model this receipt's own verify gates assert). Receipts published for the cycle 3 and cycle 4 anchors carry 'pulsevm' instead: a forward-looking label naming an announced future execution engine rather than the family observed serving the chain. Family and engine are different axes, so a later engine change does not by itself make 'antelope' false.

actions.description: Order (normative for verification): identity, observations, artifacts, dag_root_summary. dag_root_summary.root_hex MUST equal sha256(identity.root_hex || observations.root_hex || artifacts.root_hex).

chain_id.description: chain_id of the A-Chain the inscribing transaction is on, taken from the reviewed chain profile (config/a-chain-profiles.json) the generator ran under and reconciled with FYD_<ROLE>_CHAIN_ID. The history base that resolved the tx is bound to this chain_id by that profile's allowlist. Receipts from before this field existed are on the legacy XPR Network chain (mainnet 384da888112027f0321850a169f737c33e53b388aad48b5adace4bab97f437e0). REQUIRED in v3.

block_id.description: id of the block holding the transaction, as served by the history base (Hyperion action block_id) or by /v1/chain/get_block on the same base. With chain_id it identifies the block unambiguously across a chain migration, where block_num alone may not. REQUIRED in v3.

chain_profile.description: name of the chain profile (config/a-chain-profiles.json) the generator ran under, e.g. 'xpr-mainnet'. REQUIRED in v3.

history_base.description: the history base URL that resolved and verified the transaction; one of the profile's history_bases (or, testnet rehearsal only, an explicitly allowed unlisted base).
